visuals.title: Quiz
visuals.text: Five questions. Answer along on the cards below the transcript, then hear Marco's answers.

quiz.pause_at: Pause here if you want to think it through

questions.q: EBIT is 200, the tax rate 25%, depreciation 40, capex 60, and working capital rises by 20. Unlevered free cash flow?
questions.explain: 200 × 0.75 = 150, plus 40 of depreciation, minus 60 of capex, minus the 20 increase in working capital: 110. Adding the 20 instead gives 150.
questions.explain_at: So the formula is EBIT times one minus the tax rate

questions.q: Working capital goes up by 10. What happens to free cash flow?

options.text: Unchanged: it's on the balance sheet

questions.explain: More stock or slower-paying customers means cash sitting in the business, so subtract the full increase.
questions.explain_at: When working capital goes up, cash goes down.

questions.q: Why don't you subtract interest when calculating unlevered free cash flow?

options.text: Interest is usually too small to matter
Interest is a non-cash accounting charge
It's already deducted in reaching EBIT
The cash belongs to lenders and shareholders

questions.explain: Unlevered cash flow is for all capital providers; the cost of debt and its tax saving go into the weighted average cost of capital instead.
questions.explain_at: Unlevered means we pretend the company has no debt

questions.q: Depreciation rises by 20 and the tax rate is 25%. What happens to unlevered free cash flow?
questions.explain: EBIT falls by 20, so tax falls by 5; the 20 of depreciation is added back because it isn't cash. Net effect: up 5.
questions.explain_at: Fourth trap. EBIT falls by ten

questions.q: Lazard's DCF range for Recordati was about €45–54 a share, Rothschild's about €52–61. Where does the €53 offer sit?

options.text: Top of Lazard's, bottom of Rothschild's
Bottom of Lazard's, top of Rothschild's

questions.explain: €53 is near the top of Lazard's range and near the bottom of Rothschild's, so the argument is about whose cash flow forecasts you believe.
questions.explain_at: Fifty-three is near the top of Lazard's range
